correctness.rationale: Direct Peirce-component argument shows all K-linear derivations inner, uniquely modulo scalar matrices. An idempotent derivation is semisimple, forcing the nilpotent part of its triangular inner generator to vanish using commuting additive Jordan decomposition. Flag-compatible eigenvectors give unitriangular diagonalization, and matrix-unit eigenvalues enforce pairwise diagonal differences in {0,1}. This yields exactly ordered cuts for char !=2 or arbitrary binary labelings for char2. Each orbit has size q^c, and rank equals c=k(n-k), giving the stated sums over arbitrary finite fields. Independent exhaustive modular matrix calculations checked 9 small prime-field cases; they are supportive, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The full rank spectrum of composition-idempotent derivations is a natural invariant of the derivation space for every triangular matrix algebra, across all dimensions and characteristics. The binary-labeling freedom in characteristic two is a structural phase transition, not an arbitrary finite slice. Exact orbit multiplicities and rank distributions address the complete invariant, complement known counts of triangular idempotent matrices.
